description: Zero-rated export supply of goods to EU customer (reverse charge on customer side)
notes: Under VATCA s.21 and s.34, supplies of goods to a person in another EU member state are charged at zero rate. The output VAT is 0%. The rule 'Zero-rated supply' exists in the KB. Review required because the zero-rate rule carries reviewStatus 'ai_extracted'.
